races.paceDynamic: Cave Article will set a solid, sustainable pace from the front with minimal pressure in this small field. Tom Desjy may attempt to race prominently but has shown a tendency to fade late, leaving Cave Article largely uncontested through the early stages. The lack of genuine pace pressure will create a tactical affair where the front runner can dictate terms and kick clear when ready. This measured tempo heavily favours the leader and prominent racers who can track the pace without being asked serious questions until late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Cave Article gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: Cave Article can control the race from pillar to post, kicking clear when ready with the field struggling to reel him back. The lack of pace pressure allows him to save energy for a decisive move.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swamp
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian and bunches the field
scenarios.body: Delgany Deadline and Huckleberry Sting can use their finishing kicks to devastating effect in the final furlong. The Skelton runner particularly thrives when getting a soft lead to aim at.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Queens Wish tracks Cave Article and outbattles him
scenarios.body: The ex-Skelton mare can use her class advantage to wear down Cave Article in a head-to-head battle up the straight. Her recent Warwick effort suggests she has the engine for this level.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Cave Article goes too slow and gets swamped late
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses converge in a messy finish where stamina and jumping become decisive factors. Crac De Megaudais could emerge from the pack if finding his old form.

watchPoints.text: Cave Article could get such an easy lead that he becomes impossible to catch in the straight
Tom Desjy's tendency to fade in the finish could see him weaken dramatically if making early running
Delgany Deadline may struggle with the step up to 3m½f having looked best over shorter trips recently
Huckleberry Sting faces a significant class jump from winning a Bangor maiden to this competitive handicap
Queens Wish needs to prove she can transfer her ability effectively to this new yard

runners_data.name: Seaview Rock
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 79-day break with cheekpieces fitted, likely to lead or track leader under in-form Sean Bowen

runners_data.name: Dunkerque
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs strong pace to be effective, recent Hexham winner but relies on others going fast enough early

runners_data.note: Prominent style but concerning chase record (0-5) and hasn't run for over a year, wearing cheekpieces suggests connections trying everything
runners_data.comment: Useful hurdler but hasn't offered a lot over fences and a while since he tried them
runners_data.spotlight: Strike-rate of 5-13 over hurdles and he's rated 10lb lower as a chaser (0-5); however, hasn't offered a lot in this discipline and it's over a year since he last went chasing.

runners_data.name: Kara Sacre
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 80-day layoff following fall last time, needs to prove fitness after lengthy absence

runners_data.name: Rule Me In
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying 25lbs less than rivals but poor recent chase form with six defeats, needs everything to fall right
runners_data.comment: Disappointing since switched to chasing in the autumn (six attempts)
runners_data.spotlight: Won over hurdles on rules debut in February 2025, but disappointing since switched to chasing in the autumn (six attempts); he was beaten 40l+ over about 2m4f on both outings in March.

races.paceDynamic: Seaview Rock will likely set the pace from the front with Doc McCoy and Kara Sacre tracking prominently, creating a controlled tempo in this small field. The two hold-up horses Dunkerque and Rule Me In will need the pace to collapse to get competitive from off the pace. With limited early pressure on Seaview Rock, the gallop may lack intensity until the business end. This moderate pace scenario clearly favours the prominent racers who can track the leader and pounce, rather than back-markers needing a strong gallop to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Prominent Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Seaview Rock sets a steady pace without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent trio can settle comfortably and the race becomes a tactical battle from 3f out. This allows the classier prominent runners to use their tactical speed advantage over the hold-up pair.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Seaview Rock gets an uncontested lead and maintains kick
scenarios.body: With Sean Bowen able to dictate fractions, Seaview Rock can save energy early then find another gear when challenged. The 79-day break could have him fresh enough to sustain his effort to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too fast early or Dunkerque gets a perfect ride
scenarios.body: Dunkerque's recent Hexham win shows he has the class when getting the right set-up. Sean Quinlan times his challenge perfectly as the leaders tire in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If tactical riding leads to a stop-start gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 2f out which could suit any horse with tactical speed. Rule Me In's lighter weight becomes a significant advantage in a slowly-run affair.

watchPoints.text: Rule Me In's 25lb weight advantage could be decisive if he shows any improvement from his disappointing recent chase efforts
Doc McCoy hasn't won a chase in 0-5 attempts and the year-long absence raises serious fitness concerns despite cheekpieces being applied
Seaview Rock's 79-day break combined with cheekpieces suggests he's been freshened up specifically for this winnable opportunity
Dunkerque needs the prominent horses to set a strong pace early to be competitive from his hold-up position
Kara Sacre fell last time at Hereford and the 80-day gap raises questions about whether that incident caused any lingering issues

races.paceDynamic: Pottersjetamay and Saachi are both confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, with Saachi coming off competitive Flat runs and likely to show early pace. This creates an honest gallop from the start, with prominent runners like Paragon, Miss Kassiopi and Chico Magnifica tracking close behind. The steady tempo will prevent the race from becoming a sprint finish, allowing horses to sustain their effort over the final 3-4 furlongs. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position handy and strike turning for home, rather than pure hold-up horses who need a collapse up front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners Pottersjetamay and Saachi maintain honest fractions without going too fast
scenarios.body: The steady tempo allows prominent trackers to strike with sustained runs from 3f out, suiting those who race handy and have the class edge. Horses like Miss Kassiopi and Chico Magnifica can utilize their superior ratings from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Pottersjetamay or Saachi can dictate comfortable fractions and maintain their advantage
scenarios.body: The leader gets an uncontested lead and has enough left to resist late challengers, particularly if the pace doesn't become truly searching. Pottersjetamay's cheekpieces first-time could provide the needed improvement.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong between the two front runners
scenarios.body: The front runners soften each other up, allowing a classy hold-up horse to finish strongly from off the pace. Lheur De Gloire's class could tell despite the long absence, or Glenridding might benefit from the tongue-tie.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Improves Dramatically
scenarios.trigger: If handicap company and equipment changes spark major improvement in a lightly-raced type
scenarios.body: The race falls to a horse making significant progress, either through new headgear, wind surgery, or step into handicaps. Littletown Lad's wind operation or Liberty Looming's yard change could unlock hidden ability.

watchPoints.text: Watch for market support for Chico Magnifica whose useful Flat ability has yet to translate over hurdles
Watch the early battle between Pottersjetamay and Saachi as their duel will set up the race for others
Watch Lheur De Gloire's jumping after the long layoff as rustiness could compromise his class advantage
Watch for any late betting moves on Littletown Lad whose wind surgery might have solved previous problems
Watch McGrath From Clune's fitness on hurdles return as he was pulled up when last seen over fences

races.paceDynamic: White Riot will be the lone pace angle, likely to get an uncontested lead given the preponderance of hold-up horses in this field. With Louis Veron, King's Scholar, Sense Of Reason, Provision and Fervent all needing to be ridden patiently, White Riot can dictate terms without pressure through the early stages. The lack of pace competition means he can set sustainable fractions and still have enough left for the finish. This tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will emerge when six hold-up horses try to find racing room in the final three furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: White Riot Controls
scenarios.trigger: If White Riot gets the expected soft lead and his wind surgery has worked
scenarios.body: He can dictate comfortable fractions without pressure and kick clear when the hold-up brigade get caught in traffic behind. His previous good-ground form and tactical advantage become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and allows patient tactics to prosper
scenarios.body: The superior class horses like Louis Veron and Sense Of Reason can pick their way through and use their higher ratings to good effect. Traffic concerns diminish if White Riot goes too slowly early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Maiden Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If White Riot folds and multiple inexperienced horses converge in a bunch finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where Fervent's Flat speed or King's Scholar's consistency could prove decisive. Form lines become less reliable in a scrappy finish where positioning matters more than ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If White Riot goes off too fast early trying to avoid being caught
scenarios.body: He burns his petrol reserves and becomes a sitting duck for the closers in the final furlong. Superior stamina reserves of the hold-up horses become the winning factor despite the tactical disadvantage.

watchPoints.text: White Riot's early tempo - if he goes off too conservatively he could get swamped, but if too keen he'll empty out
Traffic problems in the straight when six hold-up horses try to find racing room simultaneously behind White Riot
Louis Veron's fitness after 213 days off, particularly if the pace becomes searching in the final half-mile
Fervent's jumping on hurdles debut - any early mistakes will compromise his Flat speed advantage
Wind surgery effectiveness for White Riot - any breathing issues will nullify his significant tactical advantage

races.paceDynamic: Prairie Diamond is the confirmed front runner and will set the pace from flag to finish, likely with minimal pressure early given the lack of other natural pace angles. Shengai Enki and Copper Beach may sit prominent but neither are aggressive early leaders. The sustainable gallop will build gradually over this extended trip, with the real contest beginning from three out as Prairie Diamond's stamina gets tested. This pace setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish from off the pace, as they'll have plenty of horse left to unleash when Prairie Diamond's bold front-running tactics inevitably come under pressure in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Prairie Diamond sets an honest but manageable pace without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up runners get the perfect setup to time their challenges and overwhelm the leader from the final flight. Horses like Eternity Rose and Duffry Trixs benefit most from being able to produce their best finishing efforts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prairie Diamond Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner's recent career-best form with first-time visor continues and he maintains stamina
scenarios.body: His all-the-way Wincanton success translates perfectly to this similar test, grinding out victory as the hold-up horses find his honest pace has taken too much out of them. The lack of early pressure allows him to dictate throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Shengai Enki or Copper Beach track Prairie Diamond closely and pounce before the hold-up horses get organized
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on Prairie Diamond while the back markers still have ground to make up. Their tactical position proves decisive in a race where timing the move perfectly matters most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Helps Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If Prairie Diamond stops quickly or jumping errors disrupt the main contenders' momentum
scenarios.body: An unfancied runner like Ballygeary or Heard That capitalizes on the disruption to the established pace narrative. Their inconsistent profiles suddenly become assets when the race falls apart tactically.

watchPoints.text: Prairie Diamond's visor effect was crucial to his Wincanton breakthrough and any head-shaking or steering issues would undermine his front-running tactics completely
Havefunontherun's 142-day absence could leave him short of peak fitness despite his previous course and distance success in similar conditions
Eternity Rose's inexperience over hurdles means watch for jumping fluency as any mistakes could derail his strong finishing kick from the rear
Copper Beach's 510-day layoff represents a massive fitness test and early signs of rustiness would rule him out quickly
Sutherland's recent poor form in cheekpieces suggests the headgear isn't working and any early struggling would confirm his decline
